what_it_is: Market-intelligence platform: nightly macro-regime, market-cycle and sector-rotation dashboards for US, China, Hong Kong, Canada and global markets, plus ~1,460 per-stock dossiers with proprietary trend, stage and confluence models.

surfaces.name: Macro Regime Dashboard
surfaces.description: US macro regime, risk radar and market state, updated nightly.

surfaces.name: US Stock Dashboard
surfaces.description: Ranked US stock board with entry, quality and context signals.

surfaces.name: Stock Dossiers
surfaces.description: ~1,460 per-ticker pages with trend, stage, confluence, ownership and options context.

surfaces.name: China A-Share Regime
surfaces.description: China A-share macro regime and sector rotation, updated nightly.

surfaces.name: Hong Kong Regime
surfaces.description: Hong Kong market regime and sector rotation, updated nightly.

surfaces.description: Canadian market regime and sector rotation, updated nightly.
